sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.Brand AS brand, MAX(cpt.val) AS categoryPath FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = p.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pw.PortalId OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT_WS(@pathSep, g4.Name, g3.Name, g2.Name, g1.Name) AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity ke INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity kv ON kv.VersionId = ke.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog kc ON kc.PublishCatalogId = ke.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g1 ON g1.VersionId = ke.VersionId AND g1.ZnodeCatalogId = ke.ZnodeCatalogId AND g1.LocaleId = ke.LocaleId AND g1.Name = ke.CategoryName AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, g1.ZnodeCategoryId, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, ke.ZnodeCategoryIds, @comma)) > @zero LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h1 ON h1.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g1.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g2 ON g2.VersionId = g1.VersionId AND g2.LocaleId = g1.LocaleId AND g2.ZnodeCatalogId = g1.ZnodeCatalogId AND g2.ZnodeCategoryId = h1.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h2 ON h2.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g2.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g3 ON g3.VersionId = g2.VersionId AND g3.LocaleId = g2.LocaleId AND g3.ZnodeCatalogId = g2.ZnodeCatalogId AND g3.ZnodeCategoryId = h2.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h3 ON h3.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g3.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g4 ON g4.VersionId = g3.VersionId AND g4.LocaleId = g3.LocaleId AND g4.ZnodeCatalogId = g3.ZnodeCatalogId AND g4.ZnodeCategoryId = h3.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId WHERE ke.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND kc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND kv.RevisionType = @publishState AND kv.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND ke.IsActive = @isActive AND ke.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND ke.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY ke.VersionId DESC, ke.ProductIndex, ke.PublishProductEntityId, g1.ZnodeCategoryId) cpt WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND p.Brand = @brand AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) GROUP BY p.SKU, p.ProductName, p.Brand HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed ORDER BY p.SKU
